question.problem:
Consider the vectors $\mathbf{v}_1$ and $\mathbf{v}_3$ and the block diagonal matrix $B$ shown below, where both $2 \times 2$ blocks of $B$ represent rotation-scaling matrices:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14245038/assets/68d39dc9fbe16467e2039054956fafa2818ba7978262472c34aa01eab12330dc.svg)
The vectors $\mathbf{v}_1$ and $\mathbf{v}_3$ are the eigenvectors of a matrix $A$ corresponding to the eigenvalues $\lambda_1=7 + 4\textrm{i}$ and $\lambda_3=-3 + 2\textrm{i},$ respectively. 
Given that $A=PBP^{-1},$ find a possible matrix $P.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that if $A$ is a $4\times 4$ real matrix that has complex eigenvalues 

$\qquad$ ${\color{red}\lambda_1}=\overline{\color{red}\lambda}_{\color{red}2} \quad$ and $\quad {\color{blue}\lambda_3}=\overline{\color{blue}\lambda}_{\color{blue}4}$ 

with corresponding eigenvectors 

$\qquad$ ${\color{red}\mathbf{v}_1} = \overline{\color{red}\mathbf{v}}_{\color{red}2} \quad$ and $\quad {\color{blue}\mathbf{v}_3} = \overline{\color{blue}\mathbf{v}}_{\color{blue}4},$ 

then $A=PBP^{-1},$ where
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14245038/assets/e217aa741bc60bcbacc8be44916b8c98a5f2433a2473bdb308467a032fcdc5d8.svg)
and
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14245038/assets/66248fe00b7c6c8b246cf434e181cb6eb8377df791d19e2031760414f01a54f1.svg)
Swapping the blocks on the main diagonal of $B$ will result in switching the corresponding columns in $P.$

From our block diagonal matrix
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14245038/assets/b170bd9280cab68d887b417f5eb3b7ff6d61f78094939ab76f9e7c98bb43f4cc.svg)
we deduce that the first and second columns of $P$ will correspond to the complex eigenvector ${\color{red}{\mathbf{v}_1}},$ and the third and forth columns of $P$ will correspond to the complex eigenvector ${\color{blue}\mathbf{v}_3}.$ Therefore,
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14245038/assets/6f5efdb321ab6b4f1e55b75d03262c7b4437fcbe2de7af853ba7cf562877efe5.svg)
